Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
If played on a vampire, does it cost 1+2 pool, or just 2 pool? It would have
been betetr if card text said "pay an additional 1/2 pool to play on a
vampire" instead of "2pool" since there's already a pool cost to the card
and now you don't know if that's included in the cost...

Roger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The card costs 1 pool. The effect (if played on a non-mortal) costs 2 pool.
